whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Nandani Sweets,

I noticed your sweet shop has a stellar 5.0★ rating in Rajbansi Nagar, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for local mithai and snack deliveries.

Maine aapki dukan ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, festive sweet gifting inquiries, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/nandani

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Nandani Sweets team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp sweet ordering and your Rajbansi Nagar location details. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact sweets, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
